title: Routing seam policy-field vocabulary
description: The declared POLICY vocabulary of the routing authority (issue #426, ADR-0015). These are the fields of the routing policy the authority reads to produce a decision. They are not wire fields: no caller sends them and no peer package produces them. They are listed here as their own vocabulary so the ownership map must account for each one by name, and so a policy field that loses its producer is refused rather than silently unowned. Each key below is the authority's own field, mapped to the live declared policy under gateway/sme-routing/policies/ (read-only here; the seam changes nothing there).

fail_safe_route.meaning: The route an undeclared task type takes when no positive signal selects one. Enforced to be the deep path, so unrecognised work escalates rather than slipping through cheaply.
fail_safe_route.constraint: must remain the deep path; the loader refuses the policy otherwise

complexity_to_tier.meaning: The band map from a 0..100 complexity score to a model tier.
complexity_to_tier.constraint: bands are half-open integer ranges and must cover 0..100

task_overrides.meaning: Per-task-type tier overrides that take precedence over the complexity band for a named task type.
task_overrides.constraint: keys are normalised (underscore to hyphen) and a collision after normalisation is refused

tier_escalation_ladder.meaning: The per-tier fallback chain the authority climbs on a cap breach, terminating at a null fallback.
tier_escalation_ladder.constraint: acyclic, strictly increasing, terminating at a null fallback (the declared human hand-off)
